name: @zhushanwen/pi-ext-guards
description: Shared runtime-environment guards for Pi extensions — oncePerProcess(key, fn) dedupes cross-session side-effect operations against pi factory re-invocation and handler accumulation (shared library, not a Pi extension, zero dependencies).
